title: Candon mulls calamity state due to El Niño; 5,000 rice farmers at risk

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The city government of Candon in Ilocos Sur is preparing to declare a state of calamity as the looming impacts of El Niño threaten rice farms, water supply, and public health, Mayor Eric Singson said. “We are being guided by the advice of the president to be ready for the El Niño phenomenon,” Singson said in a video statement on Oct. 7. The mayor added that the declaration would be based on current weather advisories and national government guidance on the effects of El Niño.
